title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 28
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 28: the wicked who flee when no one pursues, confessing sins, working your land, and giving to the poor.

questions.text: Who flees when no one pursues, according to the first verse?
questions.explanation: The verse says the wicked flee when no one pursues, but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

questions.text: According to this chapter, who is better than he who is perverse in his ways and rich?
questions.explanation: The saying is: better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways and rich.

answers.text: The wise son of a king
The poor who walks in his integrity

questions.text: What does this chapter say about the prayer of one who turns away his ear from hearing the law?
questions.explanation: The verse says that for him who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.

answers.text: Even his prayer is an abomination
His prayer will still be heard
His prayer must be made twice

questions.text: According to this chapter, who finds mercy?
questions.explanation: The verse says that he who conceals his sins doesn't prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

answers.text: Whoever confesses and renounces his sins

questions.text: What is a wicked ruler over helpless people compared to?
questions.explanation: The verse says that as a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.

answers.text: A driving rain that leaves no crops
A net spread for the feet
A roaring lion or a charging bear

questions.text: What will the one who works his land have, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says one who works his land will have an abundance of food, but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.

questions.text: What does the stingy man who hurries after riches not know?
questions.explanation: The verse says a stingy man hurries after riches and doesn't know that poverty waits for him.

questions.text: Who will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue?
questions.explanation: The verse says one who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.

answers.text: One who gives a piece of bread

questions.text: What does this chapter call one who trusts in himself?
questions.explanation: The verse says one who trusts in himself is a fool, but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.

questions.text: What does this chapter say about one who gives to the poor?
questions.explanation: The verse says one who gives to the poor has no lack, but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.

answers.text: He will be made a ruler
